extraction.name: RoboBench
extraction.description: A comprehensive evaluation benchmark for multimodal large language models as embodied brains, covering 5 dimensions, 14 capabilities, 25 tasks, and 6092 QA pairs.
extraction.creator: Yulin Luo, Chun-Kai Fan, Menghang Dong, Jiayu Shi, Mengdi Zhao, Bo-Wen Zhang, Cheng Chi, Jiaming Liu, Gaole Dai, Rongyu Zhang, Ruichuan An, Kun Wu, Zhengping Che, Shaoxuan Xie, Guocai Yao, Zhongxia Zhao, Pengwei Wang, Guang Liu, Zhongyuan Wang, Tiejun Huang, Shanghang Zhang
extraction.publisher: Peking University, Beijing Academy of Artificial Intelligence, Fudan University, University of Science and Technology Beijing, Beijing Innovation Center of Humanoid Robotics
extraction.citeAs: Yulin Luo, Chun-Kai Fan, Menghang Dong, et al. RoboBench: A Comprehensive Evaluation Benchmark for Multimodal Large Language Models as Embodied Brain. arXiv:2510.17801v1, 2025.
extraction.rai:dataCollection: Data combine large-scale real-world robotic datasets (e.g., RH20T, Open X-Embodiment, RoboMIND, AgiBot World Colosseo) with curated in-house collection.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionType: Secondary Data analysis, Direct measurement, Manual Human Curator, Software Collection, Experiments
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: Open-source robotic datasets (RH20T, Open X-Embodiment, RoboMIND, AgiBot World Colosseo) and in-house collected robotic data.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Data filtering during construction: general criteria (image quality, task validity) and task-specific rules (e.g., excluding single-arm data from dual-arm tasks). Post-construction validation by 20 professionally trained annotators for linguistic clarity, answerability, and correctness. Majority-vote strategy: items all models solve correctly are removed; items all models fail are manually reviewed and corrected.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Annotations generated by VLMs (Gemini), detection models, and human experts. For planning: Gemini generates structured annotations (task summaries, step-wise instructions with timestamps, metadata) refined by human annotators. For perception: template-based QA from metadata, GPT-generated functional properties, Gemini-segmented video steps, manual annotations of positions and keypoint changes. For affordance: representative frames annotated with static, dynamic, and navigation affordances. For failure: execution-level failures from RoboMIND labeled by experts; planning-level failures synthesized by perturbing correct instructions.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationAnalysis: Quality control: two-stage process (data filtering during construction, post-construction validation). Majority-vote strategy: items all models solve correctly removed; items all models fail manually reviewed.
extraction.rai:annotationsPerItem: 1 (for most tasks; multiple-choice, planning, point prediction)
extraction.rai:dataBiases: Models exhibit severe degradation on implicit instructions (30% drop), poor performance on robot-view recognition and temporal grounding, struggles with dual-arm coordination and rare-object reasoning, shallow affordance prediction, and execution-level failure diagnosis remains hardest dimension.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: Current MLLMs exhibit only superficial embodied reasoning and world-modeling capabilities. Limitations include difficulties with implicit instruction comprehension, spatiotemporal reasoning, cross-scenario planning, fine-grained affordance understanding, and execution failure diagnosis.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: Training, Testing, Validation, Fine Tuning; evaluating MLLMs as embodied brains for robotic manipulation.
